transformation_chain.behavior: Takes goal.constraints (array of strings) and stores them as hardConstraints (line 260: hardConstraints: [...(goal.constraints ?? [])]). Does NOT translate prose constraints into executable AcceptanceCheck objects.
transformation_chain.evidence: Line 260 of goal-compiler.ts: `hardConstraints: [...(goal.constraints ?? [])]`. The compiler never calls any function that would convert 'npm test MUST exit 0' into `{ kind: 'command', command: 'npm test', expectExit: 0 }`.

transformation_chain.behavior_pre_g7_19f: When parsing acceptanceCriteria from POST body, only accepted kind: 'file', 'content-in-artifacts', 'hash-match'. ALL OTHER KINDS (including 'command') were SILENTLY SKIPPED (line 482: 'Unknown kinds are silently skipped — the structural floor still applies.').
transformation_chain.behavior_post_g7_19f: Added an `else if (kind === 'command' && typeof c.command === 'string')` branch that accepts command-type criteria and propagates them.

transformation_chain.behavior_pre_g7_19f: AcceptanceCheckInput union only had 3 variants: file, content-in-artifacts, hash-match. The 'command' variant was not in the type.
transformation_chain.behavior_post_g7_19f: Added a 4th variant: `{ kind: 'command'; label: string; command: string; expectExit?: number; expectOutputIncludes?: string; expectOutputExcludes?: string }`.

transformation_chain.behavior_pre_g7_19f: When merging caller-supplied criteria into the checks array, only handled kind: 'file', 'content-in-artifacts', 'hash-match'. Caller-supplied 'command' checks would be silently dropped (no else branch for command).
transformation_chain.behavior_post_g7_19f: Added an `else if (c.kind === 'command')` branch that propagates the command check through to the verifier.

transformation_chain.behavior_pre_g7_19f: Already supported kind: 'command' checks natively (checkCommand method, line 590+). Runs `this.verifier.exec(check.command)` and checks exit code + stdout + stderr. UNCHANGED by G7-19F.
transformation_chain.behavior_post_g7_19f: UNCHANGED — the verifier already supported command checks; the G7-19F fix is at the gateway layer (layers 2-4) to STOP SILENTLY DROPPING them.

root_cause_summary: The user's prose requirement 'npm test MUST exit 0 within 60s' was stored as a STRING in GoalRequirements.hardConstraints (frozen layer 1). It was never translated into an executable AcceptanceCheck. If the user had supplied a `command`-type check explicitly, it would have been SILENTLY DROPPED at layers 2 (HTTP parser) and 4 (buildChecks). The verifier (layer 5) supports command checks natively but never saw them because layers 2-4 filtered them out. Three layers of silent disappearance.

g7_19f_correction.new_module_purpose: Detects executable-acceptance phrases in goal text (e.g., 'npm test', 'yarn test', 'pnpm test'). For each uncovered mention, emits per-worker auto-added command checks at verification time. The auto-added checks run in the verifier's clean room via `sh -c "cd artifacts/<workerId> && <command>"` — supporting the verifier's clean-room layout (which puts files under artifacts/<workerId>/<path>).
g7_19f_correction.buildchecks_change: Added else-if branch for kind='command' to propagate caller-supplied command checks. Added goalText parameter + auto-add invocation at the end. (src/gateway/mission-service.ts)
g7_19f_correction.missionruntime_change: Added goalContext and goalConstraints fields to MissionRuntime interface. Stored at submission time from submission.context + submission.constraints. (src/gateway/mission-service.ts)
g7_19f_correction.verifier_change: NONE — verifier already supported command checks natively (frozen contract preserved).
g7_19f_correction.frozen_contracts_modified: NONE — all 4 frozen contracts byte-identical to baseline 471823e (G7-19D) and 39aa0c6 (G7-19E).

g7_19f_auto_add_behavior.no_worker_produced_requiredFile: Emits a sentinel `sh -c "echo G7-19F blocker: ... 1>&2; exit 1"` check that always fails honestly.
g7_19f_auto_add_behavior.conservative_scope: Only detects phrases that name a specific known command. Vague phrases like 'tests must pass' or 'the application must work' are NOT auto-translated — the caller must provide an explicit command check for those.

verifier_compatibility.verifier_checkCommand_implementation: src/mission/verification.ts line 590+. Runs `this.verifier.exec(check.command)` and asserts exit code + optional stdout includes/excludes.
verifier_compatibility.verifier_clean_room_layout: Files are copied to `artifacts/<workerId>/<path>` in the verifier's workspace. The auto-added command uses `sh -c "cd artifacts/<workerId> && <command>"` to run the command in the worker's clean-room subdirectory.
verifier_compatibility.production_openbot_exec: Delegates to a real shell (OpenBot client.exec) — supports `sh -c "..."` natively.
verifier_compatibility.dev_mode_memory_computer_exec: Returns canned results (default: exit 0, empty stdout/stderr). Tests that need to verify failure must inject canned exec results via MemoryComputer.execResults.
